descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Contract
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Location: Bucharest, Romania
 Work Model: On-site
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Job Description
 We are looking for a hands-on Desktop Support & IT Hardware Asset Management Engineer to provide on-site IT support and manage the full lifecycle of IT hardware assets in our Bucharest office.
 The ideal candidate should have practical experience in both desktop support and IT hardware asset management, with the ability to troubleshoot end-user IT issues while maintaining accurate hardware inventory records and ensuring efficient asset utilization.
 Key Responsibilities
 1. Desktop Support & On-site IT Operations 
Provide on-site technical support for end users, including desktops, laptops, printers, peripherals, and other IT equipment.
Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows-based workstations and office IT devices.
Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, connectivity, and peripheral-related issues.
Respond to user requests and IT incidents in a timely manner, ensuring service quality and compliance with agreed SLAs.
Coordinate with remote IT support teams to resolve technical issues and ensure smooth daily operations.
Escalate major incidents and unresolved technical issues to the relevant support teams.
 2. IT Hardware Asset Management 
Manage the full lifecycle of IT hardware assets, including asset receiving, registration, tagging, deployment, inventory tracking, transfer, repair, and disposal.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date hardware asset records and inventory databases.
Conduct regular physical inventory checks and reconcile asset records to ensure accuracy.
Prepare periodic asset inventory reports and support internal and external asset audits.
Track asset allocation, ownership, location, status, and maintenance history.
Coordinate hardware repairs, replacements, spare parts management, and equipment returns.
Liaise with vendors and suppliers regarding hardware procurement, maintenance, and replacement.
 3. Service Coordination & Documentation 
Maintain proper documentation of IT assets, support activities, incidents, and maintenance records.
Manage and update service tickets in accordance with established IT service management procedures.
Work closely with remote IT teams and other relevant departments to support daily IT operations.
Perform other on-site IT support and asset management duties as assigned.
 Requirements
 Must-have Qualifications 
Proven hands-on experience in Desktop Support, IT Support, or End-user Computing support.
Mandatory practical experience in IT Hardware Asset Management, including hardware inventory tracking, asset registration, stocktaking, allocation, transfer, maintenance, and disposal.
Good knowledge of Windows operating systems, Microsoft Office applications, and common office IT equipment.
Hands-on experience installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting PCs, laptops, printers, and other IT peripherals.
Ability to maintain accurate IT asset records and prepare inventory reports.
Good troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and provide on-site technical support.
 Preferred Qualifications 
Experience managing IT hardware assets such as servers, PCs, laptops, printers, and networking equipment.
Familiarity with ITSM or IT asset management systems and ticketing tools.
Experience supporting IT asset audits and inventory reconciliation.
Experience coordinating with hardware vendors and service providers.
Knowledge of ITIL or IT service management practices is an advantage.
Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
 Key Skills
Desktop Support
IT Hardware Asset Management
IT Asset Management
Windows 10/11
Hardware Troubleshooting
IT Inventory Management
Hardware Deployment
Asset Lifecycle Management
IT Service Management (ITSM)
Incident Management
Vendor Coordination
